Every trial uses a separate fork_turns=none context. Twins, alternate renderings, private labels/witnesses, source implementations, prior votes and correctness feedback are withheld. Full-history builders and critics remain ineligible as blind reviewers.

Text-only review is an explicit permitted-access restriction of the earlier protocol. No tool/file/network/code/connector/memory/other-chat access is permitted. An interface smoke must demonstrate complete real delivery, startup and actual turn/message/tool-history retrieval before study dispatch. The assignment ledger freezes the complete224 views before candidate construction/scoring. Candidate bytes and qualified truth/failure witnesses freeze before delivery. The incorporated protocol requires a complete actor/rubric public-only stage-one delivery, complete record/query/operation/graph evidence, explicit status/set/counts/output when supported, and an immutable exact response/packet/context/time binding before candidate release. Incorrect but complete qualified commitments remain eligible measured outcomes; no gold-based retry/filter is permitted.

Invalid public input requires visible invalidity evidence and withholding, with null actor answer and unknown/null semantic counts. Parsed UNDERDETERMINED and INCONSISTENT have valid actor outputs and differ from source invalidity. Reviewer UNCERTAIN is a separate judgment axis and never substitutes for the semantic status.

The candidate envelope is review metadata, not a fourth actor-output status. Valid-source proposals carry one actor-output string; clean invalid-source proposals request withholding with a null actor-answer field. Candidate semantic, output-format and source-validity judgments remain separately scored.

Conditional error counts require qualified candidate truth plus protocol/exposure-valid decisive judgments. Total reach keeps every original assignment including missing, malformed, uncertain, failed construction and exposure-invalid outcomes. Undefined denominators remain undefined; always-UNCERTAIN cannot obtain qualification from zero observed errors.

The repeated roles/renderings/variants are related views of28 developer parents, not224 IID problems or a powered production calibration. Same-model fresh contexts provide procedural independence only, with no human/cross-provider/production-prose/native-context/learner-gain inference.

All packets,candidates,responses,scratch,delivery/access artifacts and derivatives remain EXCLUDED from every registered training/selection/calibration/evaluation role. The study reruns no sealed solver/renderer and changes no original corpus,model,global owner state/registry/lock/queue or frozen dose.
